proved_components: For an arbitrary native Borel probability measure on all of R, the native ContDiff-infinity compact-support weak Stein test identity holds iff the actual measure equals gammaProbability. No support, density, moments, or exponential integrability are assumed.

Derives exact withDensity by the positive-ray indicator times t exp(-t), absolute continuity, mass zero on (-infinity,0], no atoms anywhere, integrability of every monomial and the exact (n+1)! moments.
Under only native local integrability of tau*p on the positive ray, the actual compact smooth test weak derivative identity is equivalent to tau=t+C exp(t)/t almost everywhere on that ray.

Derives the actual smooth flux representative q+C, its actual derivative and interval FTC, uniqueness among continuous representatives on the positive ray, and local absolute continuity on every compact interval.
Both endpoints of the derived flux representative have limit C. Either zero endpoint, even stated using an arbitrary continuous representative of the same flux, forces tau=t almost everywhere.
The flux family is integrable on the positive ray iff C=0. For an actual weak Stein kernel, native Integrable tau gammaProbability is equivalent to tau=t almost everywhere on the positive ray.
For measurable tau, genuine finite Lebesgue expectation selects tau=t.

The actual identity integral(tau*p)=2 selects tau=t; the canonical flux integral equals 2. Existing gamma_probability_mean and gamma_probability_variance prove the actual mean 2 and centered second moment 2.
The family is nonnegative almost everywhere on the positive ray exactly for C>=0; every real C satisfies the actual compact-test weak equation.

Complete pointwise and almost-everywhere iff for the actual first and second derivatives of the two marked polynomial functions; the AE theorem uses an actual measure and can be specialized to restricted Lebesgue measure.
unproved_components: Normalized Pearson uniqueness for the stated locally absolutely continuous unknown density and the resulting Hilbert weight.

proved_components: Exact full-real-line iff between all marked Laguerre orthogonality equations and equality to the native Gamma probability, with the draft polynomial-integrability assumption. Strict positive support is derived. The polynomials are the literal finite coefficient sums in the draft. Full factorial-moment determinacy is proved through absolute-moment bounds, justified polynomially weighted exponential series, actual normalized tilted/dilated measures, and half-step continuation to all integer Laplace samples. No support or desired measure equality is assumed. The canonical Gamma density is linked to the intrinsic t*exp(-t) density by SigmaFinal.gamma_pdf_intrinsic and gamma_probability_integral.

Exact real and complex scalar heat eigenvalue-series convergence domains and sums. Exact complex shifted zeta eigenvalue-series convergence domain and sum equal to native riemannZeta. Native finite Borel measures on [0,1] are uniquely determined by all monomial integrals.
unproved_components: Trace-class domains and traces of the specific unbounded Laguerre realization; general compact-resolvent multiset recovery and unitary equivalence; construction/extraction of the weighted spectral Hausdorff measure, including multiplicities. Scalar eigenvalue sums are not defined to be operator traces.
The native diagonal compact-resolvent operator with double-log eigenvalues and the two divergent trace series.
Native Laguerre heat operator and kernel; Hille-Hardy Bessel identity; local uniform and L2 convergence, row normalization and stationary-measure versus Lebesgue kernel distinction.

proved_components: Exact scalar shifted-resolvent summability thresholds. For a native LinearPMap and a bounded ContinuousLinearMap obeying the actual two resolvent inverse equations, the domain is its range, the operator action is recovered, and a common complete resolvent determines the entire partially defined operator.
unproved_components: Heat-kernel Laplace integrals as L2 kernels; Hilbert-Schmidt versus trace-class conclusions and Hurwitz/digamma operator traces; full unbounded heat functional-calculus logarithmic inverse.
Native zeta/Fredholm/Hilbert-Schmidt regularized determinants and their full formulas, domains, and inverse zero-multiset statements.

Native self-adjoint finite-rank spectral perturbation families; entire zeta corrections; full-rank exponential interpolation argument and implicit-function construction preserving the listed invariants.

proved_components: Complete full-line finite-positive-measure scalar characterization: the given integer exponential integrals imply equality to the native Gamma measure. Integrability, strict positive support and absence of a zero atom are derived. Native finite measures on [0,infinity) are uniquely determined by their integer Laplace integrals. The scalar Gamma mixing integral holds for every nonnegative real spectral value.
unproved_components: Strong-operator Gamma mixing existence for arbitrary nonnegative self-adjoint operators; extracting scalar samples from integer eigenvectors of that operator identity; finite signed/complex total-variation measure extension.

proved_components: The underlying full compact Hausdorff moment uniqueness theorem is proved for actual finite positive Borel measures.

A native complex l2 partially defined diagonal functional calculus has the exact weighted-square-summability domain; its action on every marked integer eigenvector is f(n)e_n, and equality of these actions extracts every scalar sample.

A distinct smooth nonnegative non-Bernstein perturbation agrees with the Gamma exponent at every nonnegative integer and yields exactly the same native marked functional-calculus LinearPMap, including its domain.

The actual Gamma-weighted differential closure is unitarily represented by the complete marked basis, including exact domains. Its actual functional-calculus actions extract every integer-tail sample and recover the complete Bernstein data. The smooth witness has equal actual weighted-L2 partial maps and domains.
